chapters.title: Dear Verity, I hope this letter finds you well and settling into your new quarters in Bloem.
Dear Sister, My dearest Camille, I wanted to write you to To her grand majesty, the all-mighty Duchess of Salann
Dear Camille, As I write this, huddled on the floor of my sitting room, just before dawn...
Dear Annaleigh, Thank you so much for your letter and crate of candles.
Dear Mercy, There's simply so much I need to catch you up upon.
Dear Mercy, I'm sorry it's been an age since I've written.
Dear Annaleigh, Alexander's courtship was swift—we are engaged to be married...
Camille... I'm not even sure why I'm writing this to you.
